llm.summary: This market-report skill needs review because its downloaded runner recommends disabling agent protections to fix connection errors.

dimensions.detail: Optional document-conversion packages are proportionate. However, the current upstream client recommends --sandbox danger-full-access for connectivity failures, and the runner prints that advice. Following it would remove protections beyond the network access this workflow requires. See the [client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensedeal/cue-skills/main/cue-research/scripts/cue_api.py) and [runner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensedeal/cue-skills/main/cue-research/scripts/research_run.py).

dimensions.detail: The flagged health-check pipeline parses JSON rather than executing downloaded code. It reads the Cue key for authentication without printing it, although this contradicts the documentation's absolute prohibition on viewing keys.

llm.guidance: Review and pin the downloaded runner before use. Keep sandbox protections enabled and permit only the network access needed for Cue. Your queries go to Cue, and optional recurring reports consume credits; enable scheduling only if you want that ongoing usage.
